title: Ethiopian Kitfo with Spiced Berbere Sauce
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish made with raw lamb mince, marinated in spices and served with a flavorful berbere sauce. This recipe is inspired by the rich flavors of Ethiopian cuisine.

ingredients.name: raw lamb mince
ingredients.notes: Make sure to source high-quality, grass-fed lamb

ingredients.name: berbere spice blend
ingredients.notes: You can find berbere spice blend at most African or Middle Eastern markets

ingredients.name: clarified butter
ingredients.notes: Ghee is a good substitute for clarified butter

ingredients.name: fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh parsley is used as garnish

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.notes: Grated fresh ginger adds depth to the dish

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic is used in the berbere sauce

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: Chopped onion is sautéed in the berbere sauce

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lemon juice adds brightness to the dish

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together lamb mince, berbere spice blend, ginger, garlic, and onion.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in the lemon juice and clarified butter.
Serve the kitfo immediately, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
To make the berbere sauce, heat the clarified butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the berbere spice blend and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the lemon juice and stir to combine.
Season the sauce with salt to taste.
